bio: The world's largest association for security professionals, ASIS International has 243 chapters around the globe. Wherever you are in your career, whether just getting started or a seasoned security professional, ASIS International has the tools, information, and global network you need to achieve your goals. Put the power of ASIS to work for you.  www.asisonline.org

Our #MyASIS community is unmatched. We are in awe of our members’ dedication to the profession and each other, who are always looking for ways to support their colleagues and friends. In honor of Membership Appreciation Month we ask that you share your appreciation for your fellow members, maybe someone who has influenced your career or helped you in your ASIS journey? Tag a member in the comments below and be entered to win a FREE GSX All-Access Pass to #GSX2026. #ASISMemberAppreciation
